caveats: Quadrature constant taken from Trefethen ATAP Thm 19.3 in conservative form with additional 10x factor; verify exact statement before citation.
Enclosure bounds [lo,hi] are outward-rounded decimals; binary balls are tighter.
definition: f(N_k) = sum over n with Omega(n)=k of 1/(n log n) = int_1^inf P_k(s) ds
method: Ball arithmetic (Arb/FLINT). Error sources bounded: (A) arithmetic, (B) Mobius-series truncation for P(s), (C) Gauss-Legendre discretization via per-panel Bernstein-ellipse bounds, (D) interval-Newton certified nodes/weights, (E) tail s>=S0 via P(s)<=2.78*2^-s (s>=2), (F) tail s->1+ via P_k(s)<=log(1/(s-1))^k/k! and incomplete-Gamma bound.

parameters.quadrature_bound: Trefethen ATAP Thm 19.3 form with 10x safety factor
